key.description: Stable original source or situation plus the useful outcome. Reuse the key when proposing earlier work again; source:N is local to this assignment and is not a durable key.

prepared_work.description: Complete useful work, including the claims each source supports, relevant dates, what was checked, remaining uncertainty and any remaining choice. Include the concrete presentation plan and exact prepared asset references, or a brief for what selection should build and review.

items.description: A supplied source:N label or an original URL, file path or record identifier you read.

evidence.description: Source references only. Explain claims, dates, checks and uncertainty in the prepared work.

action.description: The exact action to propose after the remaining choice or permission is resolved. Omit when no action is offered.

useful_until.description: Last useful delivery time when the evidence establishes an exact instant. Omit or use null when unknown or inapplicable.

chat_id.description: The verified ID of the user's own chat this work belongs in, guided by current routing preferences and the originating conversation. Copy it from chat context or a tool result and explain the choice in prepared_work. Selection may revise it when the user's preferences or context call for another destination.

reply_to_message_id.description: The exact message_id of the user's earlier Muse message this help follows from, when replying to it would make the connection clear. Read the source conversation or search its history to recover a missing ID. Never use an email, provider, turn or source label as a Muse message ID.

format.description: Choose the primary presentation for this opportunity. In prepared_work, explain its purpose, content, design direction and fit for this user, with exact tools and absolute skill or template paths.
